BiblicalUsage: Sick is the word for the body in its weakness and the land in its defilement. The law names the sick woman and the sick bed, Isaiah pictures the whole head sick and the whole heart faint, and Lamentations weeps over a soul made sick by grief. The same word names the menstruous cloth, cast away as unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sickness in Scripture is never only physical: it is the sign of a world out of joint, and the God who heals the sick is the God who heals the land. The sickness of the body is the picture of the sickness of the soul, and the same Physician heals both.
